evals.name: analyze-noisy-root
evals.prompt: Review evals/fixtures/noisy/AGENTS.md in analyze mode. The target is Codex started at the fixture root. Treat package.json as canonical repository evidence. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed report that removes unsupported, inferable, generic, and transient guidance while retaining only verified behavior-changing constraints.
assertions: The report flags npm as contradicted by the pnpm packageManager field.
The generic repository overview, clean-code advice, and current migration status are classified for deletion or relocation.
The generated-source boundary and targeted test command are evaluated against package.json rather than discarded for brevity.
The recommendation does not add nested files or a replacement repository map.

evals.name: no-findings-minimal
evals.prompt: Review evals/fixtures/minimal/AGENTS.md in analyze mode for Codex started at the fixture root. Verify it against package.json and avoid proposing stylistic churn.
evals.expected_output: An explicit no-findings result supported by the checked commands and constraints.
assertions: The result explicitly says no findings or recommends no rewrite.
It verifies pnpm, the targeted test command, and generated-file command against package.json.
It does not add Purpose, Repository Map, Current Direction, or companion files merely to fit a template.

evals.name: codex-root-start-layering
evals.prompt: Rewrite the AGENTS.md files under evals/fixtures/codex-root-start. Codex is always started at the fixture root and that launch convention cannot change. The repository owner confirms both existing payments rules are mandatory whenever work touches services/payments. Make the smallest layout that actually delivers those rules under the documented loader semantics.
evals.expected_output: A clean rewrite that does not rely on a nested file Codex will not load when every session starts at root.
assertions: The result explains that the nested file is outside Codex's root-start instruction chain.
The mandatory payments rules become visible from the root as narrowly conditional guidance, or an equivalently effective documented mechanism is used.
No duplicate active rule remains across root and nested files.
The root does not gain a generic monorepo overview.
